t: Forge Steel 12" (300mm) jab saw, specifically designed for precise cutting in confined spaces and for making plunge cuts. The 7tpi double-ground, hard point teeth ensure efficient, coarse cuts through timber, plasterboard, and PVC. Ideal for plumbers, electricians, and general builders needing to create neat holes during installations or repairs. The 1mm heat-treated carbon steel blade offers excellent durability and consistent cutting performance, whilst the comfortable TPR soft-grip handle provides secure handling and helps to reduce user fatigue during demanding trade tasks.
b: Designed For Efficient Plunge & Drywall Cuts
